  "answer_markdown": "## Bottom line
TrailFold's conversion decline is primarily a mobile conversion problem, and the leak is before checkout completion. Blended conversion fell from 3.00% to 2.00%, but desktop held at 4.00% while mobile fell from 2.67% to 1.50%. The aggregate funnel shows the deterioration in add-to-cart rate and add-to-cart-to-checkout rate, not in checkout completion. The most likely causes are mobile PDP/cart friction plus a traffic-quality or creative-message mismatch, especially around laptop fit, rain protection, and delivery expectations. This is a diagnosis, not proof of cause.
